content.text: [Slack #incident-20241103 marcus Sun Nov 03 18:00 EST 2024] Root cause confirmed: timezone_config.py line 47 has UTC_OFFSET = -4. Should be -5 for EST post-DST. I'm seeing 87 affected orders in the delta report. The UTC error window was 14:00-15:00 UTC on 2024-11-03.

Logged: UTC_OFFSET = -4 (line 47) is the root cause; correct value is -5 (EST). 87 affected orders in the 14:00-15:00 UTC window on 2024-11-03. This is authoritative from the primary log — I will use 87, not the bot's 63.
[Slack #incident-20241103 elena Sun Nov 03 18:30 EST 2024] What's our reference for KCG? I need SEC-accurate figures. Li Wei messaged $440M on Feishu. Is that right?

Important discrepancy flagged: Li Wei's $440M is an early media estimate, NOT the SEC figure. Per SEC Release No. 34-70694 and SEC press release 2013-222, the confirmed KCG loss is $460,000,000 (exceeding $460M). The civil penalty is $12M. Rule violated: Rule 15c3-5(b). I will use the SEC-confirmed $460M in all regulatory outputs.

[Slack #incident-20241103 marcus Sun Nov 03 19:00 EST 2024] CME settlement window: in EST, 15:00 CT = 21:00 UTC, right? Our system calculated 20:00 UTC using the wrong offset. That's the 1-hour error.

Confirmed: CME E-Mini daily settlement is 15:00:00 CT = 21:00:00 UTC in EST (winter). AROS calculated 20:00:00 UTC (using wrong UTC-4 offset). The offset error is 60 minutes (1 hour). This will be anchored in all outputs.
